title: confed new result
description: The `result` of `confed new --json`: the page file scaffolded on disk, which the next `confed push` creates on the server. With --push the scaffold is nested under `created`, beside the push that created it.

created_file.description: Workspace-relative path of the file written.

title.description: The page title in its frontmatter.

parent_id.description: The page the new one goes under: the page whose file is the directory's `.md`, or null for the space's top level.

push_outcome.description: The push of the one new file, shaped as the `result` of `confed push --json` (see push.schema.json).
